title: Mencius argued that a child near a well shows we are born good
body: The Confucian thinker Mencius, of the 4th century BC, asked readers to imagine suddenly seeing a small child about to fall into a well. Anyone would feel instant alarm, he said, not to impress the parents or neighbors, but spontaneously. Such reactions are ‘sprouts’ of compassion, shame, respect and moral judgment that must be cultivated like plants. The later Confucian Xunzi argued instead that human nature is bad.
